protocol.heldout_unit: independent chromosome; repeated parameter points are reported together
protocol.missingness: complete calls only; missing-call robustness not established
protocol.uncertainty_coverage: not assessed; bootstrap intervals are not calibration evidence
protocol.rate_sensitivity: At fixed SFS, inferred N and time scale inversely with assumed mutation rate; decline fraction is invariant. This structural sensitivity is not a recovery experiment.
protocol.limitation: 10 Mb diagnostic panel is not full-prior or target 100 Mb validation; dadi and moments share the same two-epoch biological model
